features.heroBody: Feature engineering produced 81 base features. After removing zero-variance (−1), highly-correlated >0.95 (−13), and LightGBM zero-importance (−2) we kept 65. Adding anomaly-score features (+3) and GNN embeddings (+16), then dropping protected attributes is_female, age (−2), we feed 82 dimensions into the XGBoost / LightGBM / CatBoost stacking ensemble.

featureCat.userDesc: KYC anomalies (second-level = bot), late-night registration, gender/occupation risk. e.g. kyc_speed_sec, account_age_days, is_female, reg_hour
featureCat.fiatDesc: Net outflow, deposit/withdraw ratio anomalies, smurfing detection. e.g. twd_dep_sum, twd_net_flow, twd_smurf_flag
featureCat.cryptoDesc: Multi-wallet dispersion, cross-chain movement. e.g. crypto_wit_sum, crypto_wallet_hash_nunique, crypto_protocol_diversity
featureCat.tradingDesc: One-way buys, market-order wash trading. e.g. trading_buy_ratio, swap_sum, trading_market_order_ratio
featureCat.ipFlowDesc: IP switching, late-night operations, fast fund in-and-out. e.g. ip_unique_count, ip_night_ratio, fund_stay_sec
featureCat.topologyDesc: Fund hubs, fraud-ring clustering. e.g. pagerank_score, connected_component_size, betweenness_centrality
featureCat.derivedDesc: Recent activity acceleration. e.g. total_tx_count, weekend_tx_ratio, velocity_ratio_7d_vs_30d
featureCat.amlDesc: Fiat-in → crypto-out funnel, smurfing. e.g. twd_to_crypto_out_ratio, same_day_in_out_count, tx_amount_cv
featureCat.temporalDesc: Regular-pattern detection, burst trading. e.g. tx_interval_mean, tx_interval_min, active_days
featureCat.compositeDesc: Multi-dimensional weighted risk score. e.g. composite_risk_score
featureCat.anomalyDesc: Isolation Forest, HBOS, LOF — three unsupervised anomaly scores (added downstream).
featureCat.gnnDesc: HeteroSAGE + GAT learns node representations on the user–wallet heterogeneous graph, PCA-reduced to 16 dims.
